definitions.explanation: Refers to a quantity of two or more. Used both as a grammatical term (plural number) and in everyday language to mean 'multiple' or 'several.' The opposite of 単数 (singular).

examples.japanese: {複数|ふくすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。

⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{単数|たんすう}→単数：04510_tansuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{複数|ふくすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In English, nouns have a distinction between singular and plural.

examples.japanese: {複数|ふくすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Multiple witnesses gave the same testimony.

notes:
USAGE:
{複数|ふくすう} is commonly used as a pre-noun modifier: {複数|ふくすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. In grammar, it refers to the plural form. In everyday use, it is a slightly formal way to say "multiple" or "several." Japanese nouns do not have grammatical plural forms, so this concept is mainly encountered when learning other languages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {複数|ふくすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: multiple people
- {複数|ふくすう}{形|けい}: plural form (grammar)
- {複数|ふくすう}{回|かい}: multiple times
- {複数|ふくすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選択肢|せんたくし}→選択肢：14418_sentakushi⟧: multiple options
- ⟦{単数|たんすう}→単数：04510_tansuu⟧・{複数|ふくすう}: singular and plural

SIMILAR WORDS:
{複数|ふくすう} is somewhat formal. In casual speech, ⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (some people), いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (some, several), or ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧〜 (several ~) are more natural. ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧ (majority, many) implies a larger quantity than {複数|ふくすう}.
